Name: Night of Promise
When: May 29th (Time TBD)
Where: Streaming on TBN, Daystar, GodTV, and social platforms (YouTube, Facebook, etc)
What:
The program will focus on three things:
     Encouragement-we want to encourage Christians during this difficult time. God is faithful.
     Shavuot/Pentecost-2000 years ago, the Holy Spirit was poured out on the church. The times were difficult then also but in the midst of the upheaval, God did a great work.  Tonight, we are believing for another Pentecost in our nation and around the world.
         Message of revival-God wants to bring good out of this experience we are all going through and revive our land!  The time for revival is now.
         Message of unity-now more than ever, we need to band together as Believers (this night unites Jewish Believers with Christian leaders) to stand together as one. Now is our opportunity to be united just as they were in one accord on that original Pentecost. (we are currently in Pentecost tonight according to the Jewish calendar).
         Standing with Israel:
         Pentecost took place in Jerusalem. The first followers of Christ were Jews. The Jewish People remain God’s Chosen people and Israel their God-given homeland.
         Israel has also been devastated by the Coronavirus Pandemic. Unemployment has reached 30% and they are in great need of medical supplies and humanitarian aide.
         We want to encourage Christians to stand with Israel tonight through prayer and giving to help them through this difficult time. These includes both Jews and Arabs alike.
